Application No. 23039-T1

SUBSTITUTE
NARRATIVE AND PLANS

FOR THE PROPOSED ZONING AMENDMENT TYPE 1.
1223-31 W. 112" Street

The subject property contains an existing single-family home on a 100’ x 142’ lot. The
applicant seeks to rezone the subject property from an RS2 Residential (Detached
House) District to an RS3 Residential (Detached House) District. The application is for
a Type 1 Zoning Map Amendment in order to allow the division of the existing lot by
maintaining the existing single-family home located at 1223 W. 112" Street and
constructing 3 new one-story single-family homes on the remaining parcel.

The applicant is also seeking, pursuant to Section: 17-13-0303-D Optional relief for
administrative adjustments and variations and all zoning relief as needed and as
allowed by the Chicago Zoning Code.
